title: Promote a new bakery menu on Instagram
work_needed: I run a small bakery and want help promoting my new seasonal menu on Instagram.
desired_outcome: More local customers know about the new menu and visit the shop.
additional_context: Most customers are nearby families. We already post occasionally on Instagram.

brief.project_objective: Promote the bakery's new seasonal menu to local families on Instagram and encourage more shop visits.
proposed_deliverables: Three Instagram posts (images with captions) featuring the new menu items
One short caption pack the owner can reuse for stories
A simple posting schedule for the two-day window
clarifying_questions: Which menu items should be featured, and do you have photos of them?
Do you have brand colours or a logo we should use?
Is there a specific call to action, such as a limited-time offer?
acceptance_criteria: Three ready-to-post images with captions are delivered
Captions mention the new menu and a clear call to action
Content matches the bakery's existing look and feel
assumptions: The bakery already has an Instagram account
The owner can provide or approve photos of the menu items
scope_deadline_concerns: Two days is a short window if photos still need to be taken
The number of revisions the owner wants is not yet specified

title: Build a simple one-page website for a tutoring service
work_needed: We need a simple one-page website that explains our tutoring service and how to book a session.
desired_outcome: Parents can understand what we offer and contact us from a clear page.
additional_context: We do not have a logo yet, but we can provide text and a phone number.

brief.project_objective: Create a clear, mobile-friendly one-page website for a tutoring service that explains the offering and makes it easy to get in touch.
proposed_deliverables: A single responsive page with an intro, services, and contact section
Simple styling that works on phones and desktops
A short guide for the owner on how to update the text
clarifying_questions: Where will the site be hosted, and do you already own a domain?
Which contact method should be the main call to action?
What subjects and age groups should the services section list?
acceptance_criteria: The page displays correctly on a phone and a desktop
Services and contact details are accurate and easy to find
The owner has simple instructions for editing the text
assumptions: The owner can provide the text content and contact details
A simple static page is enough for now; no online booking system is required
scope_deadline_concerns: Adding online booking later would be a separate, larger task
There is no logo yet, so a simple text header will be used
